title: Twin Finance Launches Twin Assets, Bringing Tokenized Exposure to US Stocks and ETFs to Latin America, Powered by Alpaca
summary: Discover Twin Assets: tokenized US stocks and ETFs for Latin America, powered by Alpaca's brokerage and clearing infrastructure.
body_markdown:
[Twin](https://www.twin.finance/?ref=alpaca.markets) , an onchain financial infrastructure platform, recently launched[Twin Assets](https://www.twin.finance/assets?ref=alpaca.markets) , its tokenized global securities offering, for Latin America. The product gives wallets, exchanges, and fintechs that serve local investors a way to embed tokenized global assets within their own apps for their end users, without building a tokenized product themselves. The launch is powered by Alpaca, a global leader in agent-first brokerage and clearing infrastructure.


Demand for US equities across Latin America is significant. Residents of Latin America held approximately $298 billion USD in US equities as of June 2025.¹ Yet investing abroad often means opening an account with a broker that accepts international clients while paying currency conversion and transfer fees.² Twin Assets was developed to address these barriers by connecting global markets with the digital platforms people already use to manage their money.


Twin Assets provides tokenized exposure to US equities and ETFs, available through the same wallets users already have to hold digital dollars. Alpaca provides brokerage, clearing and custody services to Twin Finance Bermuda Ltd. for the underlying securities held to back Twin Assets.


According to Twin Finance, the launch coincides with several key market developments, including growing demand across Latin America for access to global markets, rising crypto and stablecoin adoption, the maturing of real-world asset tokenization under regulated frameworks such as Bermuda’s Digital Asset Business Act, and regional fintechs and exchanges that prefer plug-and-play infrastructure over building brokerage capabilities in-house.


"We were built to close a structural access gap in Latin America, where reaching global markets has long meant high costs, high minimums, and FX friction," said[Rafael De Ambrosi, CEO of Twin Finance](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rdeambrosi/?ref=alpaca.markets) . "With Twin Assets, partners and their end users get onchain exposure to global markets live in the same wallets they already use, and partners can make that exposure available to their users through a single integration."


That vision shaped how the product was built. Twin Finance designed the model to be operationally simple, with every token backed by an underlying security and an automated cycle for issuing and redeeming it, working closely with Alpaca to bring it to production. Each Twin Asset is an ERC-20 token that is backed at least 1:1 to the underlying asset held in Twin Finance’s brokerage account at Alpaca.


Twin Finance chose Alpaca’s regulated API-first brokerage because it supports an automated mint and redeem cycle. The company uses[Alpaca’s Broker API](https://alpaca.markets/broker?ref=alpaca.markets) to place orders programmatically so token issuance matches confirmed trades. Fractional trading helps keep token supply in line with the securities held, and Alpaca Crypto acts as a USDC on- and off-ramp, connecting onchain flows with the brokerage account through a single provider. That infrastructure, along with the ease of integration and Alpaca’s experience with tokenization use cases, allowed Twin to focus on its products and partners while Alpaca provides execution, clearing, and custody services for the underlying securities.


"Twin Finance has constructed a clear model for bringing global assets onchain across Latin America, and we're proud to power it as their brokerage partner," said[Yoshi Yokokawa, Co-Founder and CEO of Alpaca](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yoshiyokokawa?ref=alpaca.markets) . “By building on Alpaca’s infrastructure, Twin Finance is giving partners across the region a simpler path to global markets.”


Twin Finance plans to expand its reach across Latin America through digital wallet providers, exchanges, fintechs, and asset managers. The company also plans to broaden the range of ETFs and US equities available as underlying assets, with US Treasury bills to follow, and is exploring extended-hours trading with Alpaca to better align token issuance and redemptions with 24/7 onchain demand.
